name: Boundry
tagline: Infrastructure for applications that people and AI agents use, operate, and evolve.
description: Boundry builds infrastructure for applications that people and AI agents use, operate, and evolve, and controls the whole stack: FeltKit is product one, AppBoundry, the platform that runs application artifacts, is product two, and FeltDB, AppPort and AppPort Services form the ecosystem underneath. AuthBoundry is a separate product.

founder.name: Randy Kendel
bio: Randy Kendel founded Boundry in 2026 and built its technology: FeltDB, AppPort, AppPort Services, AppBoundry, Resolver and FeltKit.

Before Boundry he was a Product Manager – Technical at AWS, delivered CVS's Digital COVID Vaccine Scheduler across 9,600+ pharmacies in all 50 states, and ran his own technology consultancy, Kendel Consulting.
A non-traditional developer, he builds to remove complexity, so creating software feels intuitive to more than the experienced few.
